summary: Solugenix, headquartered in Brea, CA with over 20 years of experience, provides outsourced multi-tier (L1-L3) IT help-desk and technology support services for multi-unit restaurant and retail brands, including dashboards, reporting, proactive monitoring, and managed services staffed by US-based support personnel.

Solugenix's published case study for Pollo Tropical (130+ locations, previously running two separate in-house call centers) reports a 30% reduction in help-desk call volume, a 25% reduction in refund costs, and a 95% CSAT rating after transitioning IT/guest-services support to Solugenix. (Scope note: Figures are from a vendor-published case study; independent verification of the specific percentage improvements was not available in this pass.)
